summary: Specced a 4-option comparison sheet for the circular 'Continue' affordance (play.fill, chevron.right, arrow.right two-tone, and play.fill-with-notch), each as a full 1206x2622 device frame plus a ~420x420 detail crop, composited into one sheet with fixed palette/geometry/shadow-stack carried unchanged from the prior pill spec. Flagged that generation must be a faithful SwiftUI render-and-screenshot pipeline against DashboardComponents.swift, not OpenArt text-to-image synthesis, since token-accurate reproduction is the deliverable's own success criterion.
